raw_response:
This plot is only a small piece, and it is not my own land — I am just renting it, so I do not want to put too much money into it. I went to school a little, so I know fertilizer helps, but the coupon from FISP only comes for my main maize plot, not this one. Since I intercrop here, I will put some manure from my goats and a small bit of leftover urea if I have any, but I will not buy a new bag just for this small rented piece. I will use seed I saved myself, and my children and I will do all the work — no money for hired hands on a rented plot.
